commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.study_scope: Exact-source-reader fresh-input replication of maximum permitted execution count across both required count-basis strata.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Source-comparable percentage-point exact-answer accuracy difference, extra-retries/total-attempts minus complete careful English, over 32 fresh maximum-execution items with the source's two equally weighted strata and exact source readers.
admissibility_gates: authenticated routing still offers exactly 9772616720eb54968d2b81503c3c8116b99b552f7252861ad7034c7e1a357010 immediately before mint
proposal remains visible and measured with no withdrawal, supersession or active author notice; all thirteen discussion comments were read, including the later preference for independent judgment
source metric, comparator, exact ordered settlement strata and weights, Mistral/Gemma wrappers and digests, seeds, 32-token bound, temperature and serial no-retry execution are preserved
32 wholly fresh scientific items provide sixteen per required stratum; four target-independent controls run first
each n from 0 through 7 for extra-retries and 1 through 8 for total-attempts occurs twice; every reader receives one marked and one English item at every n
every marked item is compared only with its complete registered careful-English meaning; ambiguous bare retry language is absent
zero exact complete-pair or individual-arm overlap with all four recoverable prior maximum-count manifests
absolute-gap-v1 reader calibration must clear 0.5 for each reader
zero absent, off-option, truncated or transport-fault cells and full yield are required
every finite supportive, adverse, null, floor-bound or ceiling-bound result files once without retry or outcome selection
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)

planned_sample.reader_arm_balance: each reader 8/8 in each source stratum and 1/1 at every n

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: extra-retries(n) / total-attempts(n) — does “three retries” permit three executions, or four?

comparator.description: Every scientific compact form is compared with its complete registered careful-English meaning; ambiguous bare English is absent from the scalar.
